description: Search probes for the C polyglot calibration corpus. Four symbol-shaped (identifier-fragment) queries and six behavioral natural-language queries that reuse no distinctive identifiers from the target code.

probes.query: find the largest value's position in an array of measurements
the mean of just the positive numbers in a list of measurements
restrict a value so it never falls below a low bound or exceeds a high bound
flag when any entry in a list goes past a magnitude limit
count how many bits are set in a bitmask
combine three boolean checks into one overall pass or fail result
